description: This role is fully remote, open to candidates based anywhere in the United States outside New York, with a preference for the Pacific or Mountain time zones. Based in New York? Apply to the New York posting of this role instead. A Different Kind Of Job Description At Filed , we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job. So instead of a list of perks, we'll start with what's genuinely hard about it, then tell you why it might be the best move you'll make. What's hard about this job Bugs don't arrive with instructions. A customer tells you "it didn't work." Your job is to work out exactly what they did, with which return, in which tax software, and make it happen again on your own screen. If you can't reproduce it, engineering can't fix it. Your ticket is the fix's starting point. Engineers will build from what you write. Vague steps mean days of back and forth while a firm waits. You'll need to be precise every time. The pace is fast. Our customers are tax firms in their busiest weeks. When something breaks, they need an answer today, and a workaround while the real fix is built. It isn't fixed until you've checked. You'll retest every fix before telling a customer it's resolved, and you'll recheck after releases that nothing else broke. Why it might be the best career move you'll make You'll sit between customers and engineering. Few roles see both sides this clearly. You'll learn how real firms use tax software, and how software actually gets built. Your work ships. A bug you reproduce on Monday becomes a fix every firm on Filed benefits from. A workaround you find saves a firm hours the same day. You'll grow as fast as we do. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, and the support and QA function is still small. People who start here move into QA, product and engineering-adjacent roles. We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and we work with tax firms across the country, from regional practices to some of the biggest names in the profession. What You'll Own Reproducing customer-reported issues step by step, inside Filed and the tax software firms already use Writing clear, complete Linear tickets with exact steps, expected versus actual results, screenshots and sample data, so engineers can act straight away Answering customer tickets quickly and clearly in our support inbox Troubleshooting technical issues and finding workarounds that keep firms moving Verifying fixes before they go back to the customer, and regression testing after releases Spotting patterns across tickets and flagging them before they spread Your Hard Skillset Hands-on QA or software testing experience: you've reproduced bugs and written them up for an engineering team Customer support experience in a ticketing system such as Pylon, Zendesk, Intercom or Freshdesk A tax background, either at a tax or accounting fir

title: Hydrus - Voice Contributor - Spanish (Colombia)
description: Description About the Project We're looking for native-level Spanish (Colombia) speakers with professional voice recording experience to join the Hydrus Project. The project consists of two scheduled recording sessions from their own home studio. Because the recordings go straight into production, the audition validates two things equally: your voice and your recording environment. What You'll Do Audition with two 30 second samples using your home studio set up Once approved, you will complete two scheduled recording sessions of approximately 4 hours each Participate in natural conversation, prompted discussion, and scripted customer-service scenarios Record from your own home studio setup across both sessions Your Recording Environment Three things are required, and each is judged separately: An external microphone: A separate, dedicated microphone is absolutely required — see below. A dry room: Your voice should sound close and clear, with no echo or hollow, distant quality. Untreated rooms with bare walls, hard floors, and high ceilings usually fail. A quiet room: No HVAC hum, fans, traffic, appliances, or household noise during recording. Minimum Required Gear Dynamic Mics (best for untreated rooms): Shure SM58, Shure MV7 / MV7+, RODE PodMic / PodMic USB, or similar. Condenser mic (great in a treated room): RODE NT-USB Mini, Blue Yeti / Yeti Orb, Blue Bluebird, Blue Baby Bottle, or similar. Room Treatment: Your recording space should produce studio-quality sound samples – isolation shields, sounds absorbing pads, etc… Immediately rejected: built-in laptop microphones, phone mics, AirPods, Samsung Buds, headphone-attached mics, headsets, and gaming headsets. Technical Specification You must be able to produce audio samples in the meeting the following specifications: WAV format, 24-bit, 48 kHz, no compression. Free software such as Audacity can produce this. If you cannot export in this format, please do not apply — this level of technicality is required for this role. Who We're Looking For Native-level Spanish (Colombia) speaker A natural, authentic, friendly, conversational customer-service speaking style A dry, quiet home recording space and a professional microphone, as described above Good background, but not required: Podcasters, youtubers, streamers, recording artists, voice-over actors, etc – anyone who has experience recording audio in a high-quality home studio Commitment & Compensation Estimated time: approximately 8 hours total across two scheduled sessions Compensation: $35.00 USD per hour Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Senior Product Manager
description: About Manifest Manifest is building modern software for the tours and activities industry. Our customers run real-world businesses: tours, attractions, experiences, rentals, and activities. They need software that helps them sell more, operate smoothly, and deliver great guest experiences. We're building a B2B2C SaaS platform that brings booking, ecommerce, payments, accounting, operations, and customer experience together in a modern architecture. The product surface is broad, the workflows are nuanced, and the opportunity is big. That surface now spans several distinct product areas, including a newer, AI-native platform for building and delivering customer websites end-to-end. We're hiring more than one Senior Product Manager, and we'll match each hire to the area where their strengths fit best, from established features to fast-moving, zero-to-one greenfield work. We're looking for Senior Product Managers to own product direction, roadmap, and prioritization for one or more key areas of Manifest. This is not a backlog management role. We're looking for someone who can take ambiguous customer and business problems, find the shape of the opportunity, make smart tradeoffs, and help a cross-functional team ship high-quality product experiences. About the Role As a Senior Product Manager, you'll turn customer insight, business context, and technical possibilities into clear product direction and own the delivery end-to-end. Modern product work is changing, and this role reflects that. We expect our PMs to be fluent and genuinely enthusiastic users of AI-assisted tools—using Claude, Cursor, v0, and similar tools to explore interactions, build lightweight prototypes, and make product ideas concrete before implementation begins. On some of our teams, AI-native workflows are not just a way of working faster; they're central to the product itself. You'll work closely with Product leadership, Engineering, customer-facing teams, and design-minded front-end engineers. Depending on the area you own, there may not be a dedicated product designer, so you should be comfortable playing an active role in shaping user workflows, interaction patterns, and overall product quality. You'll also be the bridge between executive vision and execution: taking high-level direction set by our leadership team and honing it into concrete, buildable product requirements. Leadership helps frame the why and the what, but you own the product decisions about what to build and how to bring it to life. You do not need to be a front-end engineer, and you won't be expected to write production code. But strong technical fluency is a real advantage—enough to collaborate deeply with engineers on UI-heavy, technically nuanced product areas, and to understand the systems you're shaping. A technical or former engineering background is strongly preferred. title: Support & QA Specialist, Tax
description: This role is fully remote, open to candidates based anywhere in the United States outside New York, with a preference for the Pacific or Mountain time zones. Based in New York? Apply to the New York posting of this role instead. A Different Kind Of Job Description At Filed , we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job. So instead of a list of perks, we'll start with what's genuinely hard about it, then tell you why it might be the best move you'll make. What's hard about this job Bugs don't arrive with instructions. A customer tells you "it didn't work." Your job is to work out exactly what they did, with which return, in which tax software, and make it happen again on your own screen. If you can't reproduce it, engineering can't fix it. Your ticket is the fix's starting point. Engineers will build from what you write. Vague steps mean days of back and forth while a firm waits. You'll need to be precise every time. The pace is fast. Our customers are tax firms in their busiest weeks. When something breaks, they need an answer today, and a workaround while the real fix is built. It isn't fixed until you've checked. You'll retest every fix before telling a customer it's resolved, and you'll recheck after releases that nothing else broke. Why it might be the best career move you'll make You'll sit between customers and engineering. Few roles see both sides this clearly. You'll learn how real firms use tax software, and how software actually gets built. Your work ships. A bug you reproduce on Monday becomes a fix every firm on Filed benefits from. A workaround you find saves a firm hours the same day. You'll grow as fast as we do. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, and the support and QA function is still small. People who start here move into QA, product and engineering-adjacent roles. We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and we work with tax firms across the country, from regional practices to some of the biggest names in the profession. What You'll Own Reproducing customer-reported issues step by step, inside Filed and the tax software firms already use Writing clear, complete Linear tickets with exact steps, expected versus actual results, screenshots and sample data, so engineers can act straight away Answering customer tickets quickly and clearly in our support inbox Troubleshooting technical issues and finding workarounds that keep firms moving Verifying fixes before they go back to the customer, and regression testing after releases Spotting patterns across tickets and flagging them before they spread Your Hard Skillset Hands-on QA or software testing experience: you've reproduced bugs and written them up for an engineering team Customer support experience in a ticketing system such as Pylon, Zendesk, Intercom or Freshdesk A tax background, either at a tax or accounting fir

Vi har också blivit utsedda till en av Sveriges fem mest innovativa startups och vinnare av Post- och telestyrelsens innovationstävling "Bäst i branschen". DigitalTolk ämnar leda utvecklingen av artificiell språkintelligens och tänker fortsätta skapa möjligheter för människor att mötas, få rätt hjälp och stöd. Vi är ett dynamiskt företag där innovation är kärnan i det vi gör. Vi erbjuder dig att vara en del av en expansiv fas i vår fortsatta resa. Om rollen Vi söker nu fler medarbetare till vår kundservice som vill leverera wow-service! Här får du vara med att hjälpa människor varje dag genom innovation och tech. Som en del av vårt team kommer du att vara en viktig del av våra kunders resa varje dag. Du får möjligheten att lösa problem, ge support och skapa positiva upplevelser för våra kunder genom att använda dig av de senaste tekniska lösningarna. Rollen innefattar bland annat: Hantering av inkommande ärenden från kunder och tolkar. Tillsättning av bokningar och övrigt förekommande administrativa uppgifter. Träffa en framtida kollega: Övrigt Tjänsten är flexibel på deltid/timmar (utefter behov). Arbetsplats: Distansarbete (Stockholm). Start: Omgående. Beredskapspass ingår i rollen, utanför kontorstider enligt överenskommelse. Vem vi söker Du går den extra milen för att ge outstanding service. Du är en initiativrik, noggrann och ansvarsfull lagspelare som drivs av att göra skillnad och att tillsammans med kollegorna hitta de bästa lösningarna. Du drivs av att bygga relationer genom att ständigt vara nyfiken och genom din fantastiska kommunikationsförmåga. Du sätter våra kunder och tolkar i första rummet. För dig är det självklart att vara positiv och ambitiös. Du vill utvecklas och lära dig mer samt dela med dig av din kunskap till dina kollegor. Vi söker dig som: Formulerar dig felfritt i både tal och skrift på svenska såväl som engelska. Är flexibel och trivs i en innovativ miljö. Är en kommunikativ problemlösare som tar egna initiativ. Är noggrann, ansvarsfull och trivs med att arbeta tillsammans med andra. Har ett starkt servicefokus och tycker om att hjälpa kunder och tolkar. Project & Delivery Alignment: Steer feature initiatives from concept to production, ensuring cross-team synchronization and timely delivery against platform milestones. Workplace: We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin. Who you are: 7+ years in software engineering or technical architecture, including 3+ years working as a solution, platform, or enterprise architect. Proven experience designing platform-level architectures and system blueprints for products spanning multiple teams and domains. Strong grounding in software design patterns, distributed systems, API design, and integration architecture. Demonstrated ability to read and evaluate existing codebases to assess technical debt, risk, and implementation quality. Strong analytical and communication skills, able to translate ambiguous business requirements into clear functional and technical specifications. Experience steering cross-functional delivery and aligning engineering, product, and business stakeholders without formal line-management authority. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Nice to Have Experience in travel, mobility, or e-commerc
